continuities.name: Universal Century
continuities.summary: The original and densest Gundam continuity, centered on the Earth Federation, space colonies, Newtypes, and the long consequences of the One Year War.
continuities.watchNote: Best for viewers who want the franchise foundation; side stories are optional once the core spine is understood.

continuities.name: Future Century
continuities.summary: A tournament-driven alternate universe built around national Gundam fighters and heightened martial-arts melodrama.
continuities.watchNote: A full standalone entry; no prior Gundam viewing required.

continuities.name: After Colony
continuities.summary: The Gundam Wing universe: political colonies, aristocratic Earth power, Operation Meteor, and its direct sequel Endless Waltz.
continuities.watchNote: Watch Wing before Endless Waltz; otherwise independent.

continuities.name: After War
continuities.summary: A post-apocalyptic alternate continuity that reworks Newtype ideas outside Universal Century history.

continuities.name: Correct Century
continuities.summary: Turn A Gundam's far-future setting, often read as a meditation on Gundam history rather than a simple sequel lane.
continuities.watchNote: Can be watched alone, but rewards broad franchise familiarity.

continuities.name: Cosmic Era
continuities.summary: The Gundam SEED continuity, organized around Coordinators, Naturals, ZAFT, and recurring political/military conflicts.
continuities.watchNote: Start with SEED; Stargazer is supplemental.

continuities.name: Anno Domini
continuities.summary: Gundam 00's near-future continuity using the real-world calendar and a direct series-to-film narrative.
continuities.watchNote: Begin with 00 Season 1; the film follows Season 2.

continuities.name: Advanced Generation
continuities.summary: Gundam AGE's multi-generation story spanning family lineage and long war.
continuities.watchNote: Standalone, but Memory of Eden condenses/reframes part of the TV story.

continuities.name: Regild Century
continuities.summary: Reconguista in G's era, commonly described as a later age after Universal Century; exact meta-continuity is often discussed cautiously.
continuities.watchNote: Mostly standalone; connection to earlier eras is background texture.

continuities.name: Post Disaster
continuities.summary: Iron-Blooded Orphans' continuity, set centuries after the Calamity War and centered on child soldiers, Mars, and Gjallarhorn.

continuities.name: Ad Stella
continuities.summary: The Witch from Mercury continuity, a corporate space-age setting beginning with Prologue and continuing at Asticassia.
continuities.watchNote: Modern standalone entry; Prologue improves context.

continuities.name: Build Settings
continuities.summary: Gunpla battle stories where Gundam exists as media, models, and competitive play rather than one shared war chronology.
continuities.watchNote: Begin almost anywhere; Fighters and Divers have internal sequels.

continuities.name: Standalone / Ambiguous
continuities.summary: Animated works with SD, parody, or alternate premises that sit outside the major dramatic continuities in this MVP.
continuities.watchNote: Treat as independent unless a future expanded dataset marks a closer relationship.

paths.label: Original foundation
paths.description: For viewers who want the historical spine that made Gundam Gundam.

paths.label: Modern standalone entry
paths.description: Newer entries that explain themselves and do not require Universal Century homework.

paths.label: Universal Century essentials
paths.description: A reduced route through the central UC narrative without every side story.

paths.label: Short commitment
paths.description: Lower-episode or film routes that provide a focused taste of different Gundam modes.

methodologyNotes: Visible entries focus on animated productions. The schema keeps source IDs, relationships, and uncertainty flags so manga, novels, games, and live-action works can be added later.

Story order uses in-universe era labels when available. Compilation films share story positions with the works they summarize, but are kept as separate productions because they are distinct watch choices.
Turn A, Reconguista in G, and Thunderbolt are intentionally marked with uncertainty where franchise discussion goes beyond a simple, universally accepted viewing dependency.
Build entries are grouped by premise rather than treated as part of the war-history continuities.
